implementation.search_behavior: evaluate a small deterministic parameter-aware seed prefix at coarse fidelity, choose the best seed, replace the remaining coarse slots with shrinking positive/negative local probes around that seed, then promote the measured candidates to mid/final fidelity
implementation.resume_behavior: reuses validated CAS evaluations and candidate artifacts, then evaluates only missing fidelity work

gates.forgecad_runtime_unit: PASS: targeted CADFit integration and adaptive-search tests
gates.adaptive_search_unit: PASS: exploration budget and deterministic bounded local candidates
gates.evaluation_hash_reuse: PASS: checkpoint evaluation object hashes remained the prefix of the resumed result

limitations: This is a source/runtime recovery gate, not packaged distribution or visual quality evidence.

The optimizer remains bounded to one candidate Part and returns a proposal; the adaptive trust-region is deterministic and local, not a claim of global optimization. It does not confirm, version, or export.
Manifold boolean remains unavailable until its separate accepted C API adoption gate passes.
